beats.label: S1 · The severed floor
beats.text: Mark is promoted to lead Lumon's Macrodata Refinement after coworker Petey vanishes. His new hire Helly wakes severed and learns her outie won't let her quit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the four-person MDR unit and the severance premise the whole series hinges on.

beats.label: S1 · Petey's map
beats.text: Outside work, Petey finds Mark and reveals he reversed severance. He dies from the procedure days later, leaving Mark a hand-drawn map of Lumon's hidden hallways.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants reintegration as a real option and hands the innies the map they use to explore.

beats.label: S1 · Helly's refusal
beats.text: After Helly's outie records a video refusing her personhood, Helly hangs herself in an elevator. She survives, and the innies grasp that no one outside is coming to save them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment the innies stop hoping for rescue from their outies and start plotting for themselves.

beats.label: S1 · Departments align
beats.text: Irving grows close to Burt in Optics & Design; MDR realises Lumon has pitted the departments against each other. Together they begin mapping the severed floor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns four isolated workers into a coordinated resistance and gives Irving a stake outside his own team.

beats.label: S1 · The contingency
beats.text: Dylan discovers Lumon can wake innies inside their outies' lives—the 'overtime contingency'—and volunteers to trigger it so the others can warn the outside world.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mechanism the finale runs on; only Dylan knows how to fire it.

beats.label: S1 · Gemma is alive
beats.text: Reassembling a torn photo, Mark discovers his supposedly-dead wife Gemma is alive inside Lumon as wellness counsellor Ms. Casey.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The revelation that becomes Mark's entire engine going forward.

beats.label: S1 · Gala uprising
beats.text: Dylan triggers the contingency. Helly hijacks a Lumon gala to reveal she is CEO Jame Eagan's daughter; Mark tells Devon 'she's alive' before being pulled back inside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Simultaneously exposes severance publicly and identifies Helly as Lumon royalty—both facts drive S2.

cliffhanger.text: Dylan is tackled mid-contingency. Mark, Helly and Irving are yanked back inside Lumon before they can act on what they've just learned about their outies' lives.
questions: Will Mark's outie find Gemma before Lumon can hide her?
What does Lumon do to a team whose innies just exposed severance on live television?
Can the innies remember any of the outside world when they resume shift?

characters.name: Mark Scout
characters.line: Grieving widower who leads Lumon's Macrodata Refinement as a severed employee, now aware his 'dead' wife Gemma is alive inside the company.

characters.name: Helly R. / Helena Eagan
characters.line: New MDR hire whose outie is revealed to be Jame Eagan's daughter and Lumon heir; her innie hijacks a company gala to expose the severed workers' captivity.

characters.name: Gemma Scout / Ms. Casey
characters.line: Mark's wife, presumed dead but secretly held inside Lumon working as the severed floor's placid wellness counsellor.

characters.name: Irving B.
characters.line: Devout MDR veteran who falls for Burt in Optics & Design and helps map the severed floor after realising Lumon pits departments against each other.

characters.name: Dylan G.
characters.line: MDR refiner who discovers the 'overtime contingency' and triggers it on himself so his coworkers can broadcast the truth from inside their outies' lives.

characters.name: Petey
characters.line: Mark's former MDR chief who reversed his own severance, made contact with outie Mark, and died from the procedure after leaving him a map of Lumon's hidden halls.

beats.label: S2 · Return under new management
beats.text: Five months later, Mark wakes on a rebuilt severed floor now run by Milchick. His team returns to work, but Helena has secretly replaced her innie to spy on them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the board: new floor manager, new deputy, and an unseen imposter inside MDR.

beats.label: S2 · Reintegration
beats.text: Outside, Reghabi confirms to Mark that Gemma is alive on Lumon's testing floor. He agrees to a dangerous reintegration procedure to bridge his two selves.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Commits Mark's outie to the rescue and reactivates reintegration as a live mechanism.

beats.label: S2 · Irving unmasks Helena
beats.text: On an outdoor retreat, Irving forces Helena to confess she is not Helly by drowning her at a waterfall. Milchick fires him and ends his innie for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Irving from the board, restores real Helly, and confirms Lumon's willingness to erase people.

beats.label: S2 · The testing floor
beats.text: Innie Mark and Helly fall together while outie Mark's reintegration begins. Flashbacks reveal Gemma held on the testing floor, cycling through rooms that torture her innies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fuses the two Marks emotionally, and shows the reader the prison the finale must break.

beats.label: S2 · Cobel's secret
beats.text: Cobel returns to her ether-ruined hometown and recovers old sketches proving she—not Lumon—invented severance. Devon calls her for help with Mark's collapse.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recasts Cobel from antagonist to wild card and puts the technology's true origin in her hands.

beats.label: S2 · Cold Harbor is Gemma
beats.text: Cobel warns that finishing the Cold Harbor file will kill Gemma. Mark's outie records a video begging his innie to complete it, then rescue her from the testing floor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the terms of the finale: complete the file, lose your existence, save the wife you've never met.

beats.label: S2 · Mark chooses Helly
beats.text: Mark rescues Gemma from the testing floor and pushes her through Lumon's exit, then turns back for Helly. The two flee deeper into Lumon as alarms blare.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central choice: innie Mark refuses the rescue his outie designed him for.

cliffhanger.text: Gemma is finally outside, but Mark has abandoned her to run with Helly. Cold Harbor is broken, Drummond is dead, and Lumon's alarms are ringing over Jame Eagan, Milchick and a defiant MDR.
questions: Will Gemma reach an outie husband who barely knows her anymore?
How does Lumon punish—or use—a floor that just torched its most important project?
What does Cobel do next, now that severance's true inventor is loose and allied with Devon?

characters.name: Mark Scout
characters.line: Undergoes reintegration to bridge his two selves, then uses his innie to finish the Cold Harbor file, rescue Gemma from the testing floor, and flee back into Lumon with Helly.

characters.name: Helly R.
characters.line: Returns to MDR unaware her outie Helena has been impersonating her; after Irving exposes the swap, she reunites with innie Mark and disappears deeper into Lumon at his side.

characters.name: Helena Eagan
characters.line: Lumon heir who secretly replaced her innie to spy on MDR, until Irving forces her to confess by nearly drowning her on the company retreat.

characters.name: Gemma Scout
characters.line: Held on Lumon's testing floor cycling through rooms that torture her innies, until Mark pushes her through the severed floor's exit to freedom.

characters.name: Harmony Cobel
characters.line: Ousted former MDR manager who returns to her hometown, recovers proof that she invented severance, and warns Devon that completing Cold Harbor will kill Gemma.

characters.name: Seth Milchick
characters.line: Now running the rebuilt severed floor, he manages the returning MDR team and terminates Irving's innie after the retreat exposure.
